summary: BifrOSt has a shell-internal local contact store (one flat file, fixed fields, atomic save) that the Contacts app, Search and Share use directly. Apps read and save contacts through the SDK contacts module and the contacts service, behind a per-app access grant. Groups (nested) and a polled change history exist; containers do not. Apps with a contacts read grant get system.contacts.change when the store file changes. Since 2026-10-24 save writes every labeled value and the extra fields (prefix, nickname, job title, department, relations, social profiles, instant messages) to the sidecar, vCard keeps them, the reference error codes are mapped, and addresses and names format by country and language.
